developer.name: Abdul Moiz
developer.bio: I build Android apps that focus on clarity, speed, and everyday usefulness — from workout planners to premium Quran companions.

projects.name: HomeGym
projects.subtitle: Home Workout Plan
projects.tagline: Your personal home gym in your pocket.
projects.shortDescription: Structured workout plans you can do at home — no equipment, no gym membership, no excuses.
projects.longDescription: HomeGym is built for people who want to stay strong and consistent without stepping into a gym. Guided routines, progress tracking, and equipment-free exercises adapt to every fitness level, so building a habit finally sticks.
features: Full-body workout plans for every level
Track your streak and progress over time

projects.name: Al Quran Majeed
projects.subtitle: Read Offline
projects.tagline: Read, listen, reflect. A premium Quran companion.
projects.shortDescription: The complete Quran in your pocket — offline reading, translations, tafseer, bookmarks, and world-class reciters.
projects.longDescription: A premium, distraction-free Quran experience. Read all 114 Surahs and 30 Paras offline, follow along with translations and tafseer, and listen to world-class recitations verse by verse. Word-by-word translation makes understanding effortless.

projects.name: Crux
projects.subtitle: AI Resume Checker
projects.tagline: Get honest, AI-powered feedback on your resume.
projects.shortDescription: Upload your resume, get instant AI feedback on structure, wording, and impact — built to help you land more interviews.
projects.longDescription: Crux uses AI to review your resume the way a hiring manager would. Get a clear score, actionable suggestions, and rewritten bullet points — so your resume actually makes it past the first screen.
features: Rewritten bullet points that hit harder

projects.name: Quran Majeed
projects.subtitle: Tilawat & Recite
projects.shortDescription: A feature-rich Quran app for tilawat, translation, and reflection — with personalized reading targets.
projects.longDescription: Experience the divine beauty of the Quran with feature-rich recitation, tilawat, and English translation. Set personalized daily targets, track your progress, and build a consistent reading habit.
